    f.[OrderDate] AS [OrderDate],
    f.[TotalAmount] AS [TotalAmount],
    d1.[EmployeeId] AS [employees_EmployeeId],
    d1.[FullName] AS [employees_FullName],
    d1.[DeptId] AS [employees_DeptId],
    d1.[ManagerId] AS [employees_ManagerId],
    d2.[CustomerId] AS [tbl_customers_CustomerId],
    d2.[CustomerName] AS [tbl_customers_CustomerName],
    d2.[AcctMgrId] AS [tbl_customers_AcctMgrId],
    d3.[DepartmentId] AS [departments_DepartmentId],
    d3.[DepartmentName] AS [departments_DepartmentName]
FROM [dbo].[tbl_orders] AS f
    LEFT JOIN [dbo].[employees] AS d1 ON f.[EmpId] = d1.[EmployeeId]
    LEFT JOIN [dbo].[tbl_customers] AS d2 ON f.[CustId] = d2.[CustomerId]
    LEFT JOIN [dbo].[departments] AS d3 ON d1.[DeptId] = d3.[DepartmentId]
